instruction: Create a Thunderbird filter to automatically move all emails from sender 'spam@example.com' to the Junk folder. Configure this locally in Thunderbird only.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a filter to move emails from a specific sender to Junk folder. The evaluator verifies that an enabled filter exists with 'Move to folder' action pointing to the Junk folder.
metadata.verification: Evaluator checks Thunderbird filter configuration file for expected filter rules with appropriate action and enabled status.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: (1) filter is enabled, (2) action is 'Move to folder', (3) destination is Junk folder, (4) condition filters emails from 'spam@example.com'
The expected rules include 'condition': ['AND (from,contains,spam@example.com)'] which correctly specifies the sender filtering requirement
The metric function check_thunderbird_filter__2de049a0 properly parses the filter file, extracts conditions using regex pattern, and uses _match_record to compare all fields
The postconfig correctly closes the Message Filters window before evaluation to ensure the file state is saved
The evaluator reads from the correct Thunderbird profile path for filter rules (msgFilterRules.dat)
All semantic requirements are covered: enabled status, action type, target folder, and sender condition
